verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Make serves an llms.txt at developers.make.com that returns HTTP 200 and indexes its Developer Hub as linked .md pages. Make also documents 'Make Skills', Markdown files built to help AI assistants perform Make-specific tasks. missing for 10: the probed api-documentation.md path returned a 'Page Not Found' body (so not every page has a working Markdown version), and no independent or hands-on report of an agent consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: HTTP 200 at https://developers.make.com/llms.txt # Make Developer Hub
Make Skills are Markdown files that help your assistant reliably perform Make-specific tasks
